usedFor: Each “New Customer” in Shopify gets their email or phone checked by ApexVerify.

bestTemplate.name: “New Customer” in Shopify, then “Verify Email or Phone” in ApexVerify

watchOut: Triggers like “New Product” carry no contact to verify, so keep this pair on customers.
